description: This file contains regression tests for the Router class's _pre_call_checks() method, focusing on verifying that a performance optimization (using list() instead of deepcopy()) does not affect the correctness of list filtering behavior in the context of model deployment validation.

classes.name: TestPreCallChecksOptimization
classes.description: A test class containing test cases to verify that the optimized _pre_call_checks method preserves the input list without mutation and filters models correctly based on message length constraints.

methods.name: test_no_mutation_of_input_list(self)
methods.description: Verifies that the _pre_call_checks method does not mutate the input list or its contents by comparing object identities and values before and after the call.

methods.name: test_filtering_still_works(self)
methods.description: Ensures that the filtering logic correctly excludes deployments that cannot handle the message length while leaving the original list unaltered.
